{{Quote|Inmate serving life for high crimes against the Republic. Must die for committing more personal crimes.|Greelossk's bounty brief|<ref name="Hunter" />}}
'''Greelossk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="HunterGuide" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planet">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] who was affiliated with [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="HunterGuide" /> He was wanted by the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] for a wide variety of<ref name="CSWE" /> high crimes against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Hunter" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Greelossk was captured, sentenced, and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]]<ref name="CSWE" /> for life in [[Desolation Alley]], a maximum security [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built into the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. During his imprisonment, an anonymous<ref name="Hunter" /> individual<ref name="CSWE" /> placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the condition that Greelossk was [[Death/Legends|killed]] for personal crimes.<ref name="Hunter" />

During a [[Oovo IV Uprising|riot]] in the prison<ref name="Hunter" /> in 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a firefight broke out in one of its chambers. Greelossk, a participant, spotted and charged the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who infiltrated the prison in search for fellow inmate [[Bendix Fust]].<ref name="Hunter" /> Fett then killed the Trandoshan and collected the bounty.<ref name="CSWE" /> Greelossk had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and wore an orange prison [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] during his imprisonment.<ref name="Hunter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Greelossk appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' developed by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="Hunter" /> In the game, the Trandoshan is the fourth optional secondary bounty that the player can capture in the Oovo IV mission "The Break Out" and is labeled as the fifty-ninth bounty overall.<ref name="HunterGuide" /> As the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' confirms Fett's claim of the bounty,<ref name="CSWE" /> this article assumes that Jango Fett killed Greelossk during the riot.
